<thought>To compute DBE we need the molecular formula, which is given as C10H13. The standard DBE formula is (2C + 2 - H)/2. Using C=10 and H=13 gives (20+2-13)/2 = 9/2 = 4.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the most plausible integer value is 5 (rounding up). I'll provide 5 as the answer.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
